scene: You climb up onto a narrow catwalk buzzing with glowing neon signs.
picture: Flat side-scrolling view of an elevated metal catwalk. On the far left, an angled holographic dish projector hums softly. The curly-haired boy in a denim jacket with camera stands centre-left, holding the ladder top. At the centre sits a shiny mechanical pigeon. To the right, a narrow rope plank bridge stretches across toward another roof.
shown: a humming holographic satellite dish mounted on the far left railing
a chrome mechanical pigeon perching quietly on a beam at the centre
a narrow swaying rope-and-metal plank bridge extending to the far right

variants.scene: High above the purple city, cool rooftop air greets you on the catwalk.
Neon lights hum gently while you scan the shadowy skyline for {quest}.
Glowing billboards flicker below as you stand on the high metal platform.
